title: linaria biebersteinii subsp. maeotica
intro: Linaria biebersteinii subsp. maeotica, commonly known as the Maeotian toadflax, is a plant species belonging to the family Plantaginaceae. The Maeotian toadflax is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of stress, anxiety, and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system, with bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids contributing to its medicinal properties. Bioactive constituents of Linaria biebersteinii subsp. maeotica include flavonoids like kaempferol and quercetin, phenolic acids like ferulic and caffeic acid, and alkaloids like verbascoside, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
